description: This Java class 'TaxAssembler' provides methods to assemble TaxComponent and TaxGroup objects from JSON commands, including validation and account handling logic within the Fineract project.

classes.name: TaxAssembler
classes.description: A service class responsible for assembling TaxComponent and TaxGroup objects from JSON commands, including validation and account verification.

methods.name: assembleTaxComponentFrom
methods.description: Constructs a TaxComponent object from a JSON command, performing validation and account checks.

methods.name: assembleTaxGroupFrom
methods.description: Constructs a TaxGroup object from a JSON command, including assembling its mappings.

methods.name: assembleTaxGroupMappingsFrom
methods.description: Creates a set of TaxGroupMappings from JSON data, handling date parsing and component retrieval.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are validation errors collected during processing.
